Cyber Deception Technology
Deception technology in cybersecurity is a proactive approach to threat detection and mitigation. The primary purpose is to lure attackers into engaging with them, thereby revealing their presence and tactics. The key points of a deception technology tool include:
Fake Assets or Deception Decoy traps
Detection Mechanisms
Early Warning System
Reduction of False Positives

Threat Protection offered by Fidelis Deception
®
Platform
Credential Theft
Fidelis Deception
®
helps you identify attackers who are searching for credentials by strategically deploying fake credentials on assets that align with their search patterns. These credentials proactively lure the attackers to access the decoy traps and applications and reveal the targeted assets.
Lateral Movement Detection
Protect your valuable data and credentials by proactively luring the attackers to access decoys, breadcrumbs and fake credentials in the Active Directory.
Deception For Active Directory
Early in the inspection phase, Fidelis Deception
®
identifies how the attackers are using the seeded false items in the AD. Our deception solution also
secures Active Directory
by looking for any evidence of the attackers' activity in the AD logs.
